member.name: T:Clustering.Dendrograms.Dendrogram
member.summary: Immutable binary merge tree over leaves. Carries the sequence plus a free-text label so downstream renderers and analyses can label the y-axis correctly (e.g. "mutual_reachability_distance" for HDBSCAN, "entropy_delta" for GMM agglomerative, "single_linkage_distance" for vanilla SLINK).

remarks.para: Build invariant. is expected to be in build order — equivalently, monotone non-decreasing in . The helper relies on this; does not.
Internal-node ids. Each merge at index i in is implicitly assigned id LeafCount + i, matching the build-order convention HDBSCAN's condensation pass and scipy/MATLAB linkage expect.

member.name: P:Clustering.Dendrograms.Dendrogram.InternalNodeCount
member.summary: Number of internal merge nodes. Equals LeafCount - 1 for a fully-merged tree; smaller when the tree is truncated.

member.name: P:Clustering.Dendrograms.Dendrogram.TotalNodeCount
member.summary: Total node ids in [0, TotalNodeCount): leaves + internal nodes.

member.name: M:Clustering.Dendrograms.Dendrogram.CutToK(System.Int32)
member.summary: Cuts to clusters by applying the first LeafCount - k merges. Returns a dense int[LeafCount] of cluster labels in [0, k).
member.remarks: Requires 1 ≤ k ≤ LeafCount and a fully-merged tree (InternalNodeCount ≥ LeafCount - k). Does not depend on the build-order monotonicity invariant — only on the merge sequence itself.

member.name: M:Clustering.Dendrograms.Dendrogram.CutAt(System.Double)
member.summary: Cuts at cost level : applies all merges with ≤ . Returns a dense int[LeafCount] of cluster labels.
member.remarks: Assumes is monotone non-decreasing in (the build invariant) and short-circuits the scan at the first merge exceeding the level. For consumers needing λ-style "merges with λ ≥ level" cuts, convert level → 1/level at the call site.

member.name: M:Clustering.Dendrograms.Dendrogram.FirstLeafBelow(System.Int32)
member.summary: Resolves a node id (leaf or internal merge id) down to its representative leaf for union-find purposes. For a leaf id x < LeafCount, returns x; for an internal id LeafCount + i, walks Merges[i].LeftChild down to a leaf.

member.name: M:Clustering.Dendrograms.Dendrogram.Densify(Graphs.Primitives.UnionFind,System.Int32)
member.summary: Densifies a 's sparse root ids into dense labels in [0, clusterCount). Mirrors the SPC partition helper but kept local to avoid the cross-namespace dependency.

member.name: T:Clustering.Dendrograms.DendrogramNode
member.summary: One merge event in an agglomerative single-linkage-style dendrogram. Leaves are points 0..N-1; internal merge nodes are assigned dense ids N..2N-2 in build order. and may reference either a leaf or an internal id.

remarks.para: Cost axis. is the scalar at which the two subtrees merge. The build pass is expected to emit merges in monotone non-decreasing order — true for both Kruskal single-linkage (HDBSCAN's mutual-reachability MST) and greedy entropy merging (GMM agglomerative). The field on the enclosing wrapper documents the physical interpretation (distance, ΔH, dissimilarity).

λ convention. HDBSCAN's excess-of-mass pass consumes λ = 1/Distance; that conversion lives in the consumer (e.g. the condensation pass), not in this DTO — keeping the record neutral across cost-axis interpretations.
